title: Axiomarium hook block
description: The hook block in a hook's asset.yaml: when the harness runs the hook, what it runs, and how it responds.

event.description: When the harness runs the hook: when a session starts, or before or after the agent edits a file.

command.description: The command the harness runs, such as axm hook scope-sheriff.

response.description: What the hook does when it fires: block the action, warn the agent, or only record evidence. Prefer warn, and block only destructive actions.
